(a) Describe the single geometric transformation represented by the permutation
(i) $(\mathrm{ABCD})$;
(ii) $(\mathrm{AC})$. [4]

(i) a rotation of $180^\circ$ about $(0, 0)$;
(ii) a reflection in the line $y = 0$. [2]
The permutations representing the eight symmetries of the square form a group $\{G, \circ\}$ where $\circ$ is the operation of composition of permutations.
(c) Find the single permutation that represents $(\mathrm{ABCD}) \circ (\mathrm{AC})$. [2]
